transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble lately. With sitting through things, mostly. 

What finally pushed me to make an appointment is that I just... I keep getting up during things where I know I really should stay put. Like sprint planning meetings for work, or... or even important mortgage calls. I'll just suddenly decide I need water, or I'll get up to go check something in the other room. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Did you have similar trouble paying attention or sitting still when you were a child?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. I just remember in elementary school... teachers would end up moving my desk sometimes. Or they'd have to remind me to stay seated. 

I guess I was always just popping up, or... talking before I was called on. And I'd kind of rush through my work, even when I understood it fine. So... yeah, I did.
Do you also often feel restless or unable to keep still?

Um... yeah. I guess so. Even if I look like I'm just sitting there, it's... I don't know. 

I just feel this sort of pressure inside. Like I really need to move, or... or switch to doing something else. Or at least be doing something with my hands, or else I feel like I'm going to crawl out of my skin. So... yeah.
Do you often have trouble staying focused on tasks or conversations?

Um... sometimes, I guess. 

I mean, I'll start looking over something... like a pull request for work, or those mortgage papers I mentioned. And I mean to read it, but... after a few minutes, I'll just realize I'm staring at the exact same paragraph. And my mind is just... off on five other things that have nothing to do with it. So... yeah, I guess I do.
Do these attention problems happen in more than one setting, like both at work and at home?

Um... yeah. Both places, I guess. 

It's... well, it's been causing some friction lately. At work, and at home. People just... they have to follow up with me a lot more than they used to. And... I don't know, I just worry I'm becoming the unreliable one when it comes to planning things. Even though I really am trying hard. So... yeah. Both places.
